messages:
dana: FYI getting a sudden bump in preemptible evictions in us-west1 starting ~16:12 UTC. p95 for gen routes spiking from ~110ms -> ~360ms.

sre-bot: [ALERT] preemptible.evictions.us-west1 (15m)

leo: looking at instance termination stream and autoscaler logs now.

maia: graphs: https://grafana.internal/d/Lr3Xk/evictions?orgId=1 show evict_rate jumped to ~0.28 across zone-a/b. mixed-pool is maxed on node count.

dana: can we fail traffic to a healthier region or dedicated capacity? we have spare dedicated in west1-a but on-demand quota might be tight.

ops-lead: runbook step 2: prefer dedicated for latency-critical traffic. Runbook step 4: if quota blocks on-demand, pick secondary region.

leo: attempted resize of on-demand group +6 but got quota error: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: GPUs per project per zone exceeded".

infra-bot: quota snapshot: usable GPUs in us-west1 = 4, us-west2 = 18.

maia: proposal: quick routing change to send critical routes to dedicated-west1-a, and non-critical generation to us-west2 on-demand for now.

dana: agree. change smart-routing weights: critical -> dedicated, gen-api -> route pref west2 on-demand. keep preemptible default lower.

deploybot: routing rollout started (cfg v2026.11.02-018) by maia. canary 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 4 minutes.

leo: cache warm-up noticed in west2; model pages loading, KV cache rebuild ~30-50s per instance. expect a short drop in throughput.

maia: monitoring p95: after 2 minutes of rollout p95 dipped from 360ms -> 170ms. throughput steady.

ops-lead: cost check: cost-analytics estimates ~$5.2k extra for 2h using on-demand in west2 to absorb load. Approve up to $6k emergency spend.

cost-analytics: added note: fallback will add ~27% to tokens cost for the window.

dana: good. triggered manual failover for critical hostpool -> dedicated-west1-a.

leo: autoscaler logs show churn slowed, eviction rate trending down to 12% in last 5m.

maia: leaving routing adjustments in place for 90m. will start gradual rollback when eviction_rate < 5% sustained 10m.

infra-bot: deployed temporary alert tweak: raise evict_rate threshold to 25% for triggering auto-route change.

ops-lead: created ticket INF-7480: "mixed-pool autoscaler limits + preemptible fallback plan" with action items: quota pre-approval, autoscaler backoff tuning, graceful KV handoff.

dana: action: add heuristic to smart-router to prefer on-demand if rolling evict_rate > 20% for 10m. maia to follow up.

maia: noted, will add to INF-7480 and draft a small canary to test logic in staging.

leo: final: p95 now ~140-160ms, evict_rate back to baseline ~3%. keeping an eye for 30m then close.

sre-bot: [RESOLVED] preemptible.evictions.us-west1 at 16:36 UTC

dana: thanks all. will write a short postmortem and include cost breakdown + quota request steps. ping here if anything regrows.
